entities.summary: Louis Secretan was a Swiss lawyer, politician and mycologist. He published Mycologie Suisse in 1833, though the names are not regarded as valid unless republished by other authors. He was a member of the Swiss Academy of Sciences. The standard author abbreviation Secr. is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
